title: The necklace was paste
summary: Mme. Forestier's necklace was paste worth at most five hundred francs; the Loisels paid thirty-six thousand for a real one.
body: The diamond necklace Mme. Forestier lent was imitation (paste), worth at most five hundred francs. Only she knew. The ten years of debt were spent replacing it with a genuine diamond necklace.
